ShortDescription: One of the three ways the retailer sells goods: physical store, printed catalog, or web site.
LongDescription: Every sales and returns fact table belongs to exactly one channel. Channel is implied by the table, not stored as a column.

ShortDescription: A line item recording the sale of a quantity of one item to one customer on one date.
LongDescription: One row per item per ticket/order. Store sales are grouped by Ticket Number; catalog and web sales by Order Number. Also known as: Sale, Sales Line.

ShortDescription: A line item recording a customer returning a quantity of one item previously sold.
LongDescription: Returns reference the original sale via Ticket Number or Order Number plus Item. Not every sale has a return. Also known as: Return, Merchandise Return.

ShortDescription: A numeric fact recorded on a sales transaction line.
A numeric fact recorded on a return transaction line.
A descriptive entity used to slice facts: who, what, where, when.
System-generated integer identifier used to join fact tables to dimension tables.
LongDescription: Columns ending in _sk. Never meaningful to the business; use the corresponding Business Key (_id) for reporting.

ShortDescription: Stable, human-readable identifier for a dimension member that survives Type-2 history changes.
LongDescription: Columns ending in _id (16-character string). Several surrogate keys can share one business key when the entity has history.
SeeAlso: TPCDS Retail:Surrogate Key|TPCDS Retail:Slowly Changing Dimension

ShortDescription: A dimension that keeps history: each version is a separate row with a record start and end date.
LongDescription: Item, Store, Call Center, Web Site and Web Page are Type-2. Current version has a null record end date.

ShortDescription: A person who has purchased from any channel.
LongDescription: One row per customer. Links to current demographics and address; historical demographics at time of sale are on the fact rows. Also known as: Shopper, Buyer.

ShortDescription: On catalog and web orders, the customer who was billed for the order.
LongDescription: May differ from the Ship-To Customer (gifts, business orders).

ShortDescription: On catalog and web orders, the customer the goods were shipped to.
On catalog and web returns, the customer who received the refund (the original buyer).
On catalog and web returns, the customer who physically returned the goods.
Flag marking customers enrolled in the preferred/loyalty program.
Salutation, first and last name of the customer.
Customer date of birth, stored as separate day, month and year parts.
Country in which the customer was born.
Customer email address.
Customer web login name.
Date of the customer's first purchase in any channel.
Date of the first order shipped to the customer.
Date the customer record was last reviewed.
Personal demographic profile: gender, marital status, education, credit rating, dependents.
LongDescription: A shared lookup; many customers map to the same demographic row. Fact rows carry the demographics in effect at time of sale.

ShortDescription: Customer gender.
Customer marital status code.
Examples: M married; S single; D divorced; W widowed; U unknown

ShortDescription: Highest education level attained.
Examples: Primary; Secondary; College; 2 yr Degree; 4 yr Degree; Advanced Degree; Unknown

ShortDescription: Estimated annual purchase amount band for the customer, in whole currency units.
Credit risk classification of the customer.
Examples: Good; Low Risk; High Risk; Unknown

ShortDescription: Number of dependents in the customer's household.
Number of dependents who are employed.
Number of dependents attending college.
Household-level profile: income band, buying potential, dependents, vehicles.
Estimated household annual spending band.
Number of vehicles in the household.
Household annual income range with lower and upper bound.
Postal address; used for the customer's current address and for the address on each sale.
LongDescription: Fact rows reference the address used at time of sale, which may differ from the customer's current address.

ShortDescription: Type of dwelling at the address.
City, county, state, zip and country attributes shared by all address-bearing entities.
Time-zone offset from GMT, in hours, for a location.
A product the retailer sells. Type-2: price and attributes are versioned over time.
LongDescription: Join facts on i_item_sk to get the item version in effect at the time of sale; use i_item_id to group across versions. Also known as: Product, SKU.

ShortDescription: Display name of the item.
Current list price of the item version.
Standard per-unit cost the retailer pays for the item.
Brand of the item.
Top level of the product hierarchy.
Examples: Books; Children; Electronics; Home; Jewelry; Men; Music; Shoes; Sports; Women

ShortDescription: Second level of the product hierarchy, within a Category.
Manufacturer of the item.
Identifier of the manager responsible for the item.
Physical attributes: size, color, units, container, formulation.
A physical retail location. Type-2.
Name of the store.
Name of the store manager.
Floor space in square feet and number of employees.
Operating hours description.
Date the store closed; null while open.
Marketing region an operating unit belongs to.
Organizational division an operating unit belongs to.
Legal company an operating unit belongs to.
Sales tax rate applied at a store, call center or web site.
A facility that takes catalog orders and returns by phone. Type-2.
Name, class, size, hours and manager of a call center.
A page in a printed catalog from which an item was ordered.
Catalog number, page number, department, type and validity dates.
A retailer web property through which orders are placed. Type-2.
Name, class, manager and open/close dates of a web site.
A specific page on a web site from which an order or return originated. Type-2.
URL, type, content counts and creation/access dates of a web page.
A distribution facility that holds inventory and ships catalog and web orders.
Shipping service level and carrier used for a catalog or web order.
Service level of the shipment.
Examples: EXPRESS; NEXT DAY; OVERNIGHT; REGULAR; TWO DAY; LIBRARY

ShortDescription: Shipping company used.
A marketing campaign offering a discount on an item over a date range.
Start and end dates of the promotion.
Amount spent to run the promotion.
Marketing channels through which the promotion was communicated (Y/N flags).
Examples: dmail; email; catalog; tv; radio; press; event; demo

ShortDescription: Business purpose and response target of the promotion.
Whether the promotion's discount was in effect.
Reason code given by the customer for a return.
One row per calendar day with fiscal and calendar attributes.
LongDescription: All facts reference dates by surrogate key. Sales use the sold date; returns use the returned date; catalog/web also carry a ship date. Also known as: Date, Day.

ShortDescription: Date the sale was made.
Date a catalog or web order was shipped.
Date the return was processed.
Calendar year of the date.
Fiscal year of the date.
Calendar quarter (1-4) and quarter name.
Month of year and a monotonically increasing month sequence used for period arithmetic.
Monotonically increasing week sequence.
Day of week number and name.
Whether the date is a holiday, and whether it follows one.
Whether the date falls on a weekend.
Surrogate key of the equivalent day one year / one quarter earlier, for period-over-period comparison.
Flags marking the current day, week, month, quarter and year.
One row per second of the day with hour, minute, shift and meal-time attributes.
Work shift in which the time falls.
Meal period in which the time falls.
Identifier of a store sales receipt; groups the line items of one store visit.
LongDescription: Not unique on its own: the natural key of a store sales line is (ticket number, item).

ShortDescription: Identifier of a catalog or web order; groups the line items of one order.
LongDescription: Natural key of a line is (order number, item).

ShortDescription: Number of units of the item on the sales line.
Per-unit cost to the retailer at time of sale.
Per-unit list (undiscounted) price at time of sale.
Per-unit price actually charged before coupons.
Quantity Sold x Unit Wholesale Cost.
LongDescription: Also known as: COGS Line.

ShortDescription: Quantity Sold x Unit List Price.
Quantity Sold x Unit Sales Price. Gross line revenue before coupons and tax.
LongDescription: Also known as: Gross Sales.

ShortDescription: Quantity Sold x (Unit List Price - Unit Sales Price). Markdown from list.
LongDescription: Also known as: Markdown.

ShortDescription: Coupon discount applied to the line, after the sales price.
Extended Sales Price - Coupon Amount. Revenue the customer actually paid, before tax and shipping.
LongDescription: Also known as: Net Sales, Net Revenue.

ShortDescription: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on Net Paid.
Net Paid + Extended Tax.
Shipping charge on a catalog or web line.
Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost (catalog and web only).

TermName: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax
ShortDescription: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost + Extended Tax (catalog and web only).
Net Paid - Extended Wholesale Cost. Line-level gross profit.
LongDescription: Also known as: Gross Profit.

ShortDescription: Units returned on the line.
Value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax.
Tax refunded on the return.
Return Amount + Return Tax.
Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for the return.
Shipping cost incurred to return the goods.
Portion of the refund paid in cash.
Portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge.
Portion of the refund issued as store or account credit.
Total loss to the retailer from the return. Verify exact formula against dsdgen pricing.c before governing.
LongDescription: Derived by dsdgen from return amount including tax, fee and shipping cost, net of the refund components. Treat as a measure, not a definition, until verified.

ShortDescription: Weekly snapshot of units on hand per item per warehouse.
LongDescription: Semi-additive: sum across items and warehouses, never across dates.

ShortDescription: Units of the item held at the warehouse on the snapshot date.
SUM(Net Paid) across the selected channel(s).
LongDescription: Also known as: Revenue.

ShortDescription: SUM(Net Profit) / SUM(Net Paid). Profit as a share of net revenue.
SUM(Net Profit).
SUM(Net Paid) / COUNT(DISTINCT Ticket Number or Order Number).
SUM(Quantity Sold) / COUNT(DISTINCT Ticket Number or Order Number).
SUM(Extended Discount Amount + Coupon Amount) / SUM(Extended List Price).
SUM(Return Amount) / SUM(Net Paid) for the same channel and period.
SUM(Return Quantity) / SUM(Quantity Sold).
SUM(Net Paid) - SUM(Return Amount).
LongDescription: Also known as: Net Net Sales.

ShortDescription: Net Paid on lines with a promotion vs lines without, for the same item and period.
COUNT(DISTINCT Customer) with at least one sale in the period.
Quantity On Hand / average weekly Quantity Sold for the item.
